sup:70110.subject: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
sup:70110.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

# Holiday shutdown

email - 2025-12-17 - Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Our plant is closed from 23 December to 6 January. Please place call-offs for January by 10 December.

# Visit by the owner

meeting note - 2026-07-15 - Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Visit by the owner of Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG. He reminded us that in 2022 they kept supplying at the old price for a quarter and said he expects partnership in return.

# Price discussion

call note - 2026-08-24 - Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Call with the owner of Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: he asked where we get our index figures from - he works from his own spreadsheet, last updated two years ago.

# Payment of invoices

email - 2026-09-02 - Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Could you pay our invoices within 10 days? In return we would grant a cash discount.

# Visit by the owner

meeting note - 2026-09-09 - Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

The owner of Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG admitted he had not followed his material and energy prices closely since the 2022 peak; his office manager does the costing.

# Price adjustment from 01 November 2026

letter - 2026-09-11 - Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

Dear Sir or Madam,

we have supplied Hollerau Pumpenwerke reliably for many years. Owing to sustained increases in energy, raw material and wage costs, we are forced to adjust our prices for Volute casing HN 50-200 (part:310010) by **9.5 %** with effect from **01 November 2026**: from EUR 126.53 to EUR 138.55 per  pc.

We regret this step and ask for your understanding.

Yours faithfully,
Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

# Visit by the owner

sup:70110.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
sup:70110.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Our family foundry values the long relationship between our companies, and we appreciate your thoroughness. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. As to the index change and should cost and notice period data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point. We have carefully reviewed your data regarding the energy index and your cost model, and we respect your thoroughness. We appreciate your offer of 14-day payment terms, which we have incorporated into our revised proposal.

LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Our costs move with LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351; the figures stay with us. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.

In consideration of these points and the notice period, we are prepared to adjust our price to €134.00 per unit for an implementation on 2026-11-01. Our offer presents a price of €134.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot stays valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

sup:70110.subject: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
sup:70110.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

sup:70110.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
sup:70110.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Our family foundry values the long relationship between our companies, and we appreciate your thoroughness. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. As to the index change and should cost and notice period data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point. We have carefully reviewed your data regarding the energy index and your cost model, and we respect your thoroughness. We appreciate your offer of 14-day payment terms, which we have incorporated into our revised proposal.

LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Our costs move with LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351; the figures stay with us. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.

In consideration of these points and the notice period, we are prepared to adjust our price to €134.00 per unit for an implementation on 2026-11-01. Our offer presents a price of €134.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot stays valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

sup:70510.subject: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
sup:70510.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

sup:70510.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.
Our proposal includes a price adjustment clause on the cost driver you named.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09).
Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 348.32 per unit (po:4500014474-10, po:4500014413-10, po:4500014350-20).

We look forward to your reply.

sup:70510.subject: Re: Quote from Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
sup:70510.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

We agree to the implementation of a price adjustment clause for copper, which allows us to remove the material risk premium from our base price. We can accept your terms and await your order.

Our Angebot is valid for 30 days. We offer a price of €361.82 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, and a Preisgleitklausel on CU-NOTATION.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

sup:70530.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
sup:70530.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. As to the delivery record and volume change and should cost data you cited, our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. We have reviewed your data regarding the cost model, delivery performance, and demand forecast. While company policy currently restricts base price reductions, we can offer a price adjustment to €432.15 based on the extended 36-month contract term and 90-day payment period you proposed. 

Our current Angebot comprises a price of €432.15 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. Which volume can you commit to? Material accounts for about 42 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Logistics: Our Lieferzeit is 49 days. With overtime we can deliver in 49 days, at a premium.

case.title: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH. Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter. Need: 4580 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 54 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200003. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70530.subject: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
sup:70530.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and a Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

sup:70530.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
sup:70530.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. As to the delivery record and volume change and should cost data you cited, our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. We have reviewed your data regarding the cost model, delivery performance, and demand forecast. While company policy currently restricts base price reductions, we can offer a price adjustment to €432.15 based on the extended 36-month contract term and 90-day payment period you proposed. 

Our current Angebot comprises a price of €432.15 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. Which volume can you commit to? Material accounts for about 42 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Logistics: Our Lieferzeit is 49 days. With overtime we can deliver in 49 days, at a premium.

sup:70530.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
sup:70530.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your reply and for the step you have taken.
We can commit to 4,580 pieces per year over 36 months, as set out in our proposal below.
We understand that your price is fixed for now, so we have looked at the terms instead.

One more point from our side:
Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 412.74 per unit (po:4500014465-10, po:4500014417-10, po:4500014351-10).

Please find our proposal below.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Our current offer comprises a price of €432.15 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck

sup:70250.subject: Re: Quote from Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
sup:70250.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the energy prices and your cost model, and we can drop our price to €31.00 per unit. 

Hallo, thanks for the data. The 14-day payment term helps us a lot, so we can work with that. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. Material accounts for about 34 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351. 

So our offer is a price of €31.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days. Let's get this done.

Gruß
Claudia Fuchsreiter
Owner, Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH

sup:70250.subject: Re: Quote from Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
sup:70250.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the energy prices and your cost model, and we can drop our price to €31.00 per unit. 

Hallo, thanks for the data. The 14-day payment term helps us a lot, so we can work with that. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. Material accounts for about 34 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351. 

So our offer is a price of €31.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days. Let's get this done.

Gruß
Claudia Fuchsreiter
Owner, Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH

sup:70610.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We appreciate the increased volume forecast and your willingness to commit to a 36-month contract. While we acknowledge the delivery metric and are actively optimizing our logistics, your target price is significantly below our capabilities.

We can offer €5.56 per unit under your proposed terms of 60 days payment and a 36-month contract. Thus, our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.56 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

Logistics: We have free capacity for your parts. Our Lieferzeit is 5 days. With overtime we can deliver in 5 days, at a premium.

sup:70610.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
sup:70610.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We appreciate the increased volume forecast and your willingness to commit to a 36-month contract. While we acknowledge the delivery metric and are actively optimizing our logistics, your target price is significantly below our capabilities.

We can offer €5.56 per unit under your proposed terms of 60 days payment and a 36-month contract. Thus, our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.56 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

Logistics: We have free capacity for your parts. Our Lieferzeit is 5 days. With overtime we can deliver in 5 days, at a premium.

sup:70710.subject: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
sup:70710.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some insight into our cost environment: AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

sup:70710.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
sup:70710.body:
Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.45 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
Here is the background.
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
That is not our reality: our AS-14404 is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, so that fall does not reach our cost.
AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.
We acknowledge the recent decrease in the AS-14404 index; however, our raw material is secured at fixed prices until March 2027, limiting our ability to pass on this short-term reduction.
We can accommodate your request for a 36-month contract and 90-day payment terms, provided we include an AS-14404 index clause to manage long-term volatility.
Taking your increased volume forecast and delivery feedback into account, we propose a revised base price of €5.57.
Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.57 per unit.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Logistics: We are well loaded. Our Lieferzeit is 10 days, and with overtime we can deliver in 10 days, at a premium.

# Framework agreement 4600070710

Between Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH.

**§ 2.1** Subject: supply of Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm, peeled.

**§ 3.1** Prices as per the price annex, fixed for each calendar year. Changes require written notice of at least 60 days before the end of the calendar year.

**§ 3.2** The price follows index AS-14404: P = P0 x (1 - 0.45 + 0.45 x I(m-2) / I(base)), base = the index two months before the price year starts, adjusted quarterly on the 1st of January, April, July and October if the change exceeds 0 %.

**§ 4.1** Payment: 30 days net.

**§ 5.1** Delivery DAP; standard lead time 10 days from order.

**§ 6.1** The quality agreement applies: on-time delivery target 95 %, flat fee of EUR 150 per supplier-caused complaint.

**§ 8.1** Valid from 2024-01-01 to 2026-12-31; extends by 12 months unless terminated with 60 days' notice.

sup:70710.body:
Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.45 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
Here is the background.
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
That is not our reality: our AS-14404 is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, so that fall does not reach our cost.
AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.
We acknowledge the recent decrease in the AS-14404 index; however, our raw material is secured at fixed prices until March 2027, limiting our ability to pass on this short-term reduction.
We can accommodate your request for a 36-month contract and 90-day payment terms, provided we include an AS-14404 index clause to manage long-term volatility.
Taking your increased volume forecast and delivery feedback into account, we propose a revised base price of €5.57.
Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.57 per unit.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Between Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH.

**§ 2.1** Subject: supply of Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm, peeled.

**§ 3.1** Prices as per the price annex, fixed for each calendar year. Changes require written notice of at least 60 days before the end of the calendar year.

**§ 3.2** The price follows index AS-14404: P = P0 x (1 - 0.45 + 0.45 x I(m-2) / I(base)), base = the index two months before the price year starts, adjusted quarterly on the 1st of January, April, July and October if the change exceeds 0 %.

**§ 4.1** Payment: 30 days net.

**§ 5.1** Delivery DAP; standard lead time 10 days from order.

**§ 6.1** The quality agreement applies: on-time delivery target 95 %, flat fee of EUR 150 per supplier-caused complaint.

**§ 8.1** Valid from 2024-01-01 to 2026-12-31; extends by 12 months unless terminated with 60 days' notice.

sup:70710.body:
Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.45 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
Here is the background.
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
That is not our reality: our AS-14404 is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, so that fall does not reach our cost.
AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.
We acknowledge the recent decrease in the AS-14404 index; however, our raw material is secured at fixed prices until March 2027, limiting our ability to pass on this short-term reduction.
We can accommodate your request for a 36-month contract and 90-day payment terms, provided we include an AS-14404 index clause to manage long-term volatility.
Taking your increased volume forecast and delivery feedback into account, we propose a revised base price of €5.57.
Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.57 per unit.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

sup:70710.subject: Re: Quote from Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
sup:70710.body:
Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.45 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
Here is the background.
We checked the index change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
That is not our reality: our AS-14404 is covered at fixed prices until March 2027, so that fall does not reach our cost.
AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.
We acknowledge the recent decrease in the AS-14404 index; however, our raw material is secured at fixed prices until March 2027, limiting our ability to pass on this short-term reduction.
We can accommodate your request for a 36-month contract and 90-day payment terms, provided we include an AS-14404 index clause to manage long-term volatility.
Taking your increased volume forecast and delivery feedback into account, we propose a revised base price of €5.57.
Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.57 per unit.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.
A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.
Which volume can you commit to?
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

Logistics: We are well loaded. Our Lieferzeit is 10 days, and with overtime we can deliver in 10 days, at a premium.

# Framework agreement 4600070710

Between Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH.

**§ 2.1** Subject: supply of Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm, peeled.

**§ 3.1** Prices as per the price annex, fixed for each calendar year. Changes require written notice of at least 60 days before the end of the calendar year.

**§ 3.2** The price follows index AS-14404: P = P0 x (1 - 0.45 + 0.45 x I(m-2) / I(base)), base = the index two months before the price year starts, adjusted quarterly on the 1st of January, April, July and October if the change exceeds 0 %.

**§ 4.1** Payment: 30 days net.

**§ 5.1** Delivery DAP; standard lead time 10 days from order.

**§ 6.1** The quality agreement applies: on-time delivery target 95 %, flat fee of EUR 150 per supplier-caused complaint.

**§ 8.1** Valid from 2024-01-01 to 2026-12-31; extends by 12 months unless terminated with 60 days' notice.

Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We acknowledge your increased volume of 23,400 units and the 36-month contract term, which allows us to revise our price to €31.70. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Theoretical cost models do not reflect the specialized nature of our production and our current high capacity utilization. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown. We note your delivery data and maintain our focus on supply chain stability. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. Our proposal covers a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months, Lieferzeit 56 days, and a price of €31.70 per unit. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

We also see the volume bump and the energy index drop, so we can bring the price down to €45.50. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351.

Our current Angebot is a price of €46.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. Alternatively, with a quality commitment of 2500 ppm: €45.50 per unit, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. This offer is valid for 30 days.

Marek Lis

Kind regards

sup:70140.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
sup:70140.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. Faster payment is very important to us, so if we can improve the payment terms, we can be more flexible on other points. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. 

We also see the volume bump and the energy index drop, so we can bring the price down to €45.50. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351.

Our current Angebot is a price of €46.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. Alternatively, with a quality commitment of 2500 ppm: €45.50 per unit, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. This offer is valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

sup:70140.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
sup:70140.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. Faster payment is very important to us, so if we can improve the payment terms, we can be more flexible on other points. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. 

We also see the volume bump and the energy index drop, so we can bring the price down to €45.50. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351.

Our current Angebot is a price of €46.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. Alternatively, with a quality commitment of 2500 ppm: €45.50 per unit, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. This offer is valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

# Framework agreement 4600070740

Between Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH.

**§ 2.1** Subject: supply of Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm, peeled, Round bar 1.4021 dia 40 mm, peeled, Round bar C45 dia 50 mm, cold drawn.

**§ 3.1** Prices as per the price annex, fixed for each calendar year. Changes require written notice of at least 60 days before the end of the calendar year.

**§ 3.2** The price follows index PPI-C2431: P = P0 x (1 - 0.8 + 0.8 x I(m-2) / I(base)), base = the index two months before the price year starts, adjusted quarterly on the 1st of January, April, July and October if the change exceeds 3 %.

**§ 4.1** Payment: 30 days net.

**§ 5.1** Delivery DAP; standard lead time 14 days from order.

**§ 6.1** The quality agreement applies: on-time delivery target 95 %, flat fee of EUR 150 per supplier-caused complaint.

**§ 8.1** Valid from 2024-01-01 to 2026-12-31; extends by 12 months unless terminated with 60 days' notice.

sup:70740.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
sup:70740.body:
Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
A few words on this from our side.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.
We acknowledge your data regarding the AS-14404 index decrease, the increased demand forecast, and our recent delivery performance.
We can agree to your requested 36-month contract and 60-day payment terms, but we must include an AS-14404 index clause as we cannot fix prices for this duration.
With these terms, we propose a revised unit price of €5.50.
Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.50 per unit.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.
We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Logistics: Please note that our standard Lieferzeit is 14 days, as we currently have free capacity for your parts. With overtime we can also deliver in 14 days, though this option comes at a premium.

# Framework agreement 4600070740

Between Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH.

**§ 2.1** Subject: supply of Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm, peeled, Round bar 1.4021 dia 40 mm, peeled, Round bar C45 dia 50 mm, cold drawn.

**§ 3.1** Prices as per the price annex, fixed for each calendar year. Changes require written notice of at least 60 days before the end of the calendar year.

**§ 3.2** The price follows index PPI-C2431: P = P0 x (1 - 0.8 + 0.8 x I(m-2) / I(base)), base = the index two months before the price year starts, adjusted quarterly on the 1st of January, April, July and October if the change exceeds 3 %.

**§ 4.1** Payment: 30 days net.

**§ 5.1** Delivery DAP; standard lead time 14 days from order.

**§ 6.1** The quality agreement applies: on-time delivery target 95 %, flat fee of EUR 150 per supplier-caused complaint.

**§ 8.1** Valid from 2024-01-01 to 2026-12-31; extends by 12 months unless terminated with 60 days' notice.

sup:70740.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
sup:70740.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Alloy surcharge 1.4404, Isartal Edelstahlwerk (fictional mill, derived) changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).

sup:70740.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
sup:70740.body:
Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
A few words on this from our side.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.
We acknowledge your data regarding the AS-14404 index decrease, the increased demand forecast, and our recent delivery performance.
We can agree to your requested 36-month contract and 60-day payment terms, but we must include an AS-14404 index clause as we cannot fix prices for this duration.
With these terms, we propose a revised unit price of €5.50.
Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.50 per unit.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.
We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Our proposal includes the price adjustment clause you asked for.

One more point from our side:
Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 5.84 per unit (po:4500014427-10, po:4500014355-10, po:4500014292-10).

Please find our proposal below.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

sup:70740.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
sup:70740.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. We appreciate your flexibility in accepting the index clause and your continued trust in our partnership. In response to your step, we are pleased to offer a further reduction to €5.30 per unit under these terms.

Our updated Angebot provides a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

sup:70740.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
sup:70740.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

sup:70740.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
sup:70740.body:
Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
A few words on this from our side.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.
We acknowledge your data regarding the AS-14404 index decrease, the increased demand forecast, and our recent delivery performance.
We can agree to your requested 36-month contract and 60-day payment terms, but we must include an AS-14404 index clause as we cannot fix prices for this duration.
With these terms, we propose a revised unit price of €5.50.
Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.50 per unit.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.
We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

Between Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH.

**§ 2.1** Subject: supply of Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm, peeled, Round bar 1.4021 dia 40 mm, peeled, Round bar C45 dia 50 mm, cold drawn.

**§ 6.1** The quality agreement applies: on-time delivery target 95 %, flat fee of EUR 150 per supplier-caused complaint.

sup:70740.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
sup:70740.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

sup:70740.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
sup:70740.body:
Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
A few words on this from our side.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.
We acknowledge your data regarding the AS-14404 index decrease, the increased demand forecast, and our recent delivery performance.
We can agree to your requested 36-month contract and 60-day payment terms, but we must include an AS-14404 index clause as we cannot fix prices for this duration.
With these terms, we propose a revised unit price of €5.50.
Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.50 per unit.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.
We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.
We look forward to doing good business together, and our team is always there for you.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

**§ 2.1** Subject: supply of Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm, peeled, Round bar 1.4021 dia 40 mm, peeled, Round bar C45 dia 50 mm, cold drawn.

**§ 3.1** Prices as per the price annex, fixed for each calendar year. Changes require written notice of at least 60 days before the end of the calendar year.

**§ 3.2** The price follows index PPI-C2431: P = P0 x (1 - 0.8 + 0.8 x I(m-2) / I(base)), base = the index two months before the price year starts, adjusted quarterly on the 1st of January, April, July and October if the change exceeds 3 %.

**§ 4.1** Payment: 30 days net.

**§ 5.1** Delivery DAP; standard lead time 14 days from order.

**§ 6.1** The quality agreement applies: on-time delivery target 95 %, flat fee of EUR 150 per supplier-caused complaint.

**§ 8.1** Valid from 2024-01-01 to 2026-12-31; extends by 12 months unless terminated with 60 days' notice.
